description: Implementation of absl::time::clock functions, including high-resolution time retrieval, cycle counter-based timing, and sleep utilities, with platform-specific code and internal synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: UnscaledCycleClockWrapperForGetCurrentTime
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static method to access cycle counter-based current time.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns current time as absl::Time, using system clock or cycle counter based method.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeNanos
methods.description: Retrieves current time in nanoseconds, either from system or cycle counter, with platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: SleepOnce
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified duration, handling platform-specific sleep calls.
